messages:
Ivy: Heads up — release promo paused. Several staging jobs failed during artifact verify and an integration test flaked after artifact extract. deploy-bot put a hold.

DeployBot: Promote paused by deploy-bot at 3581234567. Reason: artifact-checksum-mismatch + integ-test-failure on checkout-canary. See https://ci.redwood/builds/21011 :no_entry_sign:

Carlos: Log excerpt from runner-4:
```
E: checksum mismatch for /tmp/artifacts/ui_bundle-4.2.0.tgz (expected sha256:aa11bb, got sha256:aa11b0)
WARNING: tar: unexpected EOF while reading archive
```

QA: Integration failure looks like a downstream DB migration race, but it only started after the extractor logged truncated archive. Two runners got full artifact, three got truncated.

sre-bot: Storage metrics: increased 499s from s3-proxy in eu-west-1 between 09:12-09:18 UTC. Ticket ST-1722 opened.

Ivy: Window for this cut ends in ~38m. Options: A) pin canary to last-good digest to meet the window, B) reupload artifact + invalidate cache then reverify (10-20m), C) force purge (uncertain). We also need to decide rollback vs pin if integration test still fails after reupload.

Carlos: Fastest is pin. I propose: 1) manual promote to `service@sha256:stable123` to unblock, 2) reupload artifact with `CACHE_KEY=$(git rev-parse --short HEAD)-fix` and `VERIFY_UPLOAD=1`, 3) run `ci-artifact-verify` NO_CACHE across 5 runners, 4) if green, retarget and remove pin; if integration test still flakes, rollback plan active.

QA: If the integration test is a separate migration race it might persist even after artifact fix. We should run the integration suite locally against the pinned digest first to check.

CI-Runner-Bot: queued `/ci retry builds/21011 --only artifacts` (4 jobs).

Ivy: Manual promote API: `/deploy promote --env=staging --service=checkout-canary --digest=sha256:stable123 --reason="pin to known-good image to meet cut window"` (requires 2 approvals).

Carlos: +1. I'll start reupload and push with multipart and explicit checksum verification.

QA: +1. I'll run integration locally against stable123 while you push.

sre-bot: Storage team investigating proxy node that returned truncated bodies. Ticket ST-1722 assigned.

DeployBot: Promote request created: ID 9220. Waiting for 2 approvals.

QA: approved.

Ivy: approved.

DeployBot: Promote executed: checkout-canary -> sha256:stable123 at 3581234604. Comment: pinned to known-good digest to unblock release window.

Carlos: Reupload finished, checksums verified locally. Kicked off `ci-artifact-verify` with NO_CACHE=1. Job link: https://ci.redwood/jobs/verify-21011-1

CI-Runner-Bot: verify job started on runners 2,4,7.

QA: Ran integration against pinned digest locally — DB migration race reproduced when I run two workers concurrently. This is a separate issue; we should not assume reupload will fix this.

Ivy: OK — we'll keep pin for cut. Post-cut action items: 1) Carlos + storage-team to root cause truncated uploads, 2) QA to triage migration race and propose DB migration lock change or sequencing, 3) add artifact upload validation in pipeline. Add release note: "Canary pinned to known-good digest due to artifact checksum mismatch and integration test flake; follow-ups scheduled (ST-1722)."

sre-bot: Noted. We'll monitor `artifact.checksum.errors` and `image.unpack.errors` during the rollback window.

Carlos: verify job passed on all runners. Will schedule retarget after cut if QA's migration fix is ready.

Ivy: Unblock confirmed. Postmortem owners: Carlos (artifact pipeline), QA (integration race), storage-team (proxy node). Thanks everyone. :raised_hands:
